summary: Inc.5 has verified entity/profile links and one relevant editorial link, but five strong media mentions are unlinked and the verified sample is concentrated on the homepage. A profile-wide quality, toxicity, anchor, velocity, lost-link and competitor-gap assessment is blocked without a row-level backlink export and Search Console access.

checks.evidence: Public aggregate only; no licensed row-level export.
checks.result: Counts are directional and cannot be reproduced or segmented.
checks.blocker: No backlink-index export or Search Console Links export.
checks.next_action: Export source URL, target URL, anchor, follow status, first/last seen, authority, traffic, country, language and live/lost status.

checks.evidence: Firecrawl inspection of five accessible media articles.
checks.result: ETRetail, IMAGES Business of Fashion, YourStory, FashionNetwork India and In Fashion Business mention Inc.5 without linking to inc5shop.com.
checks.next_action: Run a five-publication contextual link-reclamation campaign.

checks.result: Links exist across company profiles, review/domain-analysis pages, store listings and one editorial article.
checks.next_action: Refresh editable profiles and normalize destinations to https://inc5shop.com.

checks.result: www/http variants and inc5shoes.co.in resolved to https://inc5shop.com/ with a final 200 response.
checks.next_action: Keep permanent, single-hop redirects and update editable links to the canonical URL.

checks.result: The sample is mainly branded, naked-domain and generic Website anchors; no exact-match manipulation was observed.
checks.next_action: Measure branded, naked, generic, topical, exact-match, image and empty-anchor shares.

checks.result: Nearly all verified links point to the homepage; one confirmed link points to the Atesber collection.
checks.next_action: Earn relevant deep links to priority category, fit/comfort, occasion, handbag, store and guide pages.

checks.evidence: Search snippets plus Google disavow/manual-action guidance.
checks.result: Irrelevant Justdial hotel-page signals were found, but live links, scale and manual-action status are unknown.
checks.blocker: No complete backlink export and no Search Console Manual Actions access.
checks.next_action: Validate live links and Search Console status; do not disavow from snippets or toxicity scores alone.
Establish a monthly new/lost referring-domain baseline.
Compare Inc.5 with the approved competitor set using one backlink index and date.

priority_actions: Build the auditable baseline from a licensed backlink export plus Search Console Links, Manual Actions and Security Issues.
Reclaim links from the five confirmed unlinked media articles.
Normalize editable profile destinations to https://inc5shop.com.
Earn deep links to durable category, fit/comfort, occasion, handbag and store-location pages.
Monitor suspicious domains quarterly; do not disavow without live evidence and Search Console justification.
recommended_90_day_targets: Recover at least 3 of the 5 confirmed unlinked media mentions.
Earn at least 10 net-new relevant Indian fashion, retail, lifestyle, mall or business referring domains.
Route at least 40 percent of new earned links to useful deep pages.
Buy zero links and avoid scaled directory or guest-post packages.
Re-run the audit with the same data source for comparability.
